definition: Slab identity, steel grade and actual receipt, verification and release times.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE slab_material(slab_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, charge_id TEXT NOT NULL, steel_grade TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(steel_grade IN ('G1','G2')), received_at TEXT NOT NULL, verified_at TEXT, released_at TEXT, CHECK(verified_at IS NULL OR received_at<=verified_at), CHECK(released_at IS NULL OR (verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_at<=released_at)))

definition: One rolling plan per slab, its scheduled reheating time and actual submission, approval and release times.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE planned_rolling_instruction(plan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, slab_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES slab_material(slab_id), planned_reheat_at TEXT NOT NULL, submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at TEXT, released_at TEXT, CHECK(approved_at IS NULL OR submitted_at<=approved_at), CHECK(released_at IS NULL OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_at<=released_at)))

definition: An issued rolling instruction for an approved plan.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE rolling_instruction(instruction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES planned_rolling_instruction(plan_id), issued_at TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Allocated mother-material identity and genealogy for a rolling instruction; created_at and updated_at describe database maintenance, not production completion.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE as_rolled_material(material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, slab_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES slab_material(slab_id), instruction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES rolling_instruction(instruction_id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(created_at<=updated_at))

definition: Business code meanings within each manufacturing process group. The same code text can have a different meaning in another group.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE process_code(process_group TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(process_group IN ('FURNACE','ROLLING','FINISHING')), code TEXT NOT NULL, meaning TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(process_group,code))

definition: Equipment identifiers, names and system-maintenance times. Each equipment_code identifies a machine, not a manufacturing step.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE equipment(equipment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, equipment_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, equipment_name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(created_at<=updated_at))

definition: Actual furnace work occurrences for mother materials, retaining repeat work and unfinished intervals.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE furnace_operation_history(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), process_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FURNACE' CHECK(process_group='FURNACE'), operation_code TEXT NOT NULL, equipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment(equipment_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(process_group,operation_code) REFERENCES process_code(process_group,code), CHECK(finished_at IS NULL OR started_at<finished_at))

definition: Actual rolling phase occurrences for mother materials, retaining repeat work and unfinished intervals.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE rolling_operation_history(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), process_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ROLLING' CHECK(process_group='ROLLING'), phase_code TEXT NOT NULL, equipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment(equipment_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(process_group,phase_code) REFERENCES process_code(process_group,code), CHECK(finished_at IS NULL OR started_at<finished_at))

definition: Individual plate-piece identity and mother-material genealogy, with actual identification, release and packing times.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE plate_material(plate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, mother_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), identified_at TEXT NOT NULL, released_at TEXT, packed_at TEXT, CHECK(released_at IS NULL OR identified_at<=released_at), CHECK(packed_at IS NULL OR (released_at IS NOT NULL AND released_at<=packed_at)))

definition: Actual finishing work occurrences for individual plate pieces, including repeated heat treatment after rework.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE finishing_operation_history(operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plate_material(plate_id), process_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FINISHING' CHECK(process_group='FINISHING'), operation_code TEXT NOT NULL, equipment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment(equipment_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(process_group,operation_code) REFERENCES process_code(process_group,code), CHECK(finished_at IS NULL OR started_at<finished_at))

definition: One dimensional inspection record per inspection occurrence. Reinspection has a new inspection_id; PASS/FAIL describes its result.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE dimension_inspection(inspection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plate_material(plate_id), inspected_at TEXT NOT NULL, result_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result_code IN ('PASS','FAIL')), thickness_mm REAL NOT NULL CHECK(thickness_mm>0))

definition: One quality review record per review round. APPROVED/REWORK describes its outcome; PENDING means the review has not finished.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE plate_quality_review(review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, plate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plate_material(plate_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('APPROVED','REWORK','PENDING')), CHECK((review_status='PENDING' AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (review_status IN ('APPROVED','REWORK') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at<finished_at)))
